description: Cultural appropriation is the process of taking elements of a culture which is not one’s own and using them in a way which lacks respect and understanding for the context, history, and significance of those elements. It often happens when a dominant group adopts elements of a marginalized group’s culture. This can be seen in fashion, music, cuisine, language, and other aspects of culture.
